text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Make haste! We're off to overthrow the
demon lord!

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text:
Stop right there! Umamusume, schmusume!
You're just a level 1
brawler.

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text:
The name's Mercenary Machos! And I ain't
lettin' you so-called Umamusume walk
around all high and mighty. Prepare to
have your
lights knocked out.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El... Be careful.
This man has more than just
brawn up his sleeve. He's
hiding something
in his hand.

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so you noticed! That's right. I got a
secret weapon that can give
me
superhuman strength.

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text:
It's called a Growth Potion!
You just take a
sip, and—Wroaaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-wh-what?! Your body just doubled
in size!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A Growth Potion... I see.
It's a potion that
turns you into a giant.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Although... Pardon me asking, but do you
feel all right? Your muscles
look awfully
swollen and stiff...

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Cough... hack... It's just a side effect, nuthin' someone tough like me can't handle!

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text:
Double the stature, double the strength!
Imma crush you both like
little ants!
Arghhhh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, perfect timin'! Lemme be the first to
show ya—an Umamusume's
got three times
the strength of a human!

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text:
You lil' brat! Imma knock you into next
week!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah! Shrieking Condor Wave!

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text: Gahhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text:
W-was that an ult?! I've never seen a move
like that before!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That little punch? Please!
That wasn't even
a skill!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We Umamusume never get the chance to
deliver full-power punches
in the real
world, but if we did, you bet it'd be
somethin' like that!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
At most, we do pretend punches for
performances, but there's no
need to hold
back in a video game.

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... If you're that powerful, you may
truly be able to take on the
demon lord
and their servants.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ma'am, may I ask you a question about this
demon lord that's
threatening your world?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Did their arrival really come without any
sign or notice?

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The moment the demon lord
arrived, all of this world's demons and
monsters fell under their control. We've
been forced into
a corner ever since.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna beat that tyrant to a pulp!

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
You do possess extraordinary power, dear
brawler, but if the legend
is true, it likely
won't be you who defeats the demon lord.

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
"Fantasy incarnate shall look down upon
this world from the heavens. With innate,
thunderous power, she will deliver unto
the demon lord a strike of destruction and
felicity alike."

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
In the prophecy, the demon lord is bested
by a strike of thunderous
power from the
heavens.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A heavenly lightning strike... I'm not
entirely certain, but it could
mean divine
retribution from an angel, perhaps.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Your outfit looks pretty angelic! Maybe you'll learn some lightning skills... Even a demon lord wouldn't wanna face your retribution!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ow, ow! That really hurt! And
don't tell me it was an accident!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You might have a point, though. My class
does appear to be on the angelic side. Let
me check my skill tree for high level
cleric
spells.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh. There's one called "Angelic Bolt" that
summons lighting.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that could be our secret weapon.
But at the moment, my level
is nowhere
near high enough to cast it...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, I see... Well, there's only one
solution to that issue.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's time to grind some XP!
Let's see what's
around the village and
start raising our
levels!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so, we begin our adventure by
explorin' the surroundin' area!
However!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, what are you doing? You can't just
barge into someone's home and
open their
drawers.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, you can't just throw that away here.
You're polluting the
environment.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Why are you so difficult?! Now you wanna
act like heaven's oracle or
somethin'!
Leave me alone to do what I want!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El, wait!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! Heaven's oracle has come to haunt
me again!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... They might've been weak enemies, but I'm totally wiped out from all that grinding. Still, I think we did it...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Our levels are high enough to take on
the demon lord's army.
Which means the
real challenge starts now.

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text: El! Grass! It's a disaster!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Is that Machos?

text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos
text_block_list.text:
The village...
Our village is under attack!
The demon army's burning
everything!

text_block_list.name: El and Grass
text_block_list.text: Gasp?!
